"""Browser authentication-state boundary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import hashlib
import hmac
import time


def create_browser_auth_state(user_id: str, secret: str) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Build a signed, HTTP-only session cookie for the given user.

    Per ADR-AUTH, the browser only ever receives an opaque signed cookie
    value; no bearer credential (e.g. a JWT) is exposed to browser JavaScript
    or intended for localStorage.
    """
    issued_at = int(time.time())
    payload = f"{user_id}.{issued_at}"
    signature = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), payload.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    cookie_value = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(f"{payload}.{signature}".encode("utf-8")).decode("utf-8")

    return {
        "name": "session",
        "value": cookie_value,
        "http_only": True,
        "secure": True,
        "same_site": "Lax",
        "issued_at": issued_at,
    }
